title: Candy Color Paradox
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Satoshi Onoe, a principled reporter at a weekly tabloid, is paired against his will with photographer Motoharu Kaburagi, a stakeout specialist whose methods and attitude infuriate him. As they work scoops together, rivalry turns into a romance between two adult men (SuBLime blurb via AniList; ANN review; MangaUpdates).
life_message: Honesty and compassion can survive in a cynical trade, and love can grow out of rivalry.
